hard_stop_execution.adverse_open_gap: fill at bar open when the bar opens beyond the stop
hard_stop_execution.same_bar_stop_target_collision: invalid_data/intrabar_order_ambiguous unless finer event ordering resolves it

entry_contract.entry_trigger: declared route trigger on a closed decision bar with graph_version and lifecycle_version
entry_cancellation: any required gate becomes false before fill
entry_contract.entry_action: emit exactly one policy_recommendation entry action or terminal reject; never silently enter

risk_unit.definition: one risk unit is absolute entry-to-frozen-stop distance, not quantity or capital
risk_unit.stop_source: signal-bar extreme or declared swing extreme plus one tick
risk_unit.tp1_source: near structural target fixed before entry
risk_unit.tp2_source: far structural target fixed before entry

post_entry_rules.confirmation: two consecutive post-entry closed bars each close in direction and above entry for long or below entry for short; neither triggers hard stop; PA direction trace remains aligned
post_entry_rules.failed_follow_through: if the two-bar window does not confirm, emit failed_follow_through -> condition_exit at the second post-entry close
post_entry_rules.weakening: after confirmation, two consecutive adverse closes and the second close has PA §2.3 neutral/opposite or §2.5 momentum support failure; one adverse bar is an ordinary pullback
post_entry_rules.tp1_action: first valid TP1 touch exits exactly 0.5 normalized policy unit
post_entry_rules.runner: remaining 0.5 runs to TP2 or another terminal guard
post_entry_rules.stop_after_tp1: confirmed three-bar pivot ratchet only; no breakeven move merely from TP1
post_entry_rules.long_pivot: low[i] < low[i-1] and low[i] < low[i+1], known when bar i+1 closes; candidate stop low[i] - 1 tick
post_entry_rules.short_pivot: high[i] > high[i-1] and high[i] > high[i+1], known when bar i+1 closes; candidate stop high[i] + 1 tick
post_entry_rules.ratchet: long max(previous_stop,candidate_stop); short min(previous_stop,candidate_stop); never loosen
post_entry_rules.right_censoring: study cutoff may record an open episode as right_censored; it is not a synthetic exit and is not eligible for completed-outcome learning
